headline: Gravity blinked, and you didn't.
summary: You sent your fastest and most efficient line yet, skipping the lower holds to save time. The only thing slowing you down was a little too much sightseeing on the upper half of the wall. Keep that new 9-hold sequence and just move a bit faster between your hand placements.

strengths.title: Surgical precision
strengths.detail: Every single placement stuck on the first try. No fidgeting, no re-grabs, just pure confidence in your hands.

strengths.title: Efficient line-finding
strengths.detail: You skipped the small green hold low on the left, which saved you over two seconds compared to your other attempts. That's a keeper.

strengths.title: Reliable right foot
strengths.detail: Your right foot stayed glued to the small green hold near the start for 4.6 seconds, giving you a solid base to push from.

focus.title: The scenic pause
focus.detail: At 6.8s, you hung on the green hold near the top for 1.8 seconds before moving. Try to keep your momentum going and move your left foot as soon as your hand is set.

focus.title: Upper-half hesitation
focus.detail: At 2.9s, you took a 1.6-second breather on the green hold in the upper half. Focus on your next move before you get there so you can flow through without stopping.

focus.title: Left foot flight time
focus.detail: Your left foot was off a hold for 1.9 seconds around the 2.6-second mark. Try to keep it closer to the wall or on a hold to help your arms out.

drills.name: Speedy transitions
drills.how: Climb the route but try to move your feet the exact moment your hands are set, with no pauses.

drills.name: Footwork focus
drills.how: Focus on keeping both feet on holds as much as possible, even if it means taking a smaller step.

beta: Start on the big green hold in the middle, move to the green hold in the middle on the left, then the green hold in the upper half, and finish on the finish hold.
next_goal: Beat your 11.8s time by 1 second while keeping that 9-hold sequence.
